info.title: Synap Hub Protocol
info.description: REST surface for IS, agents, sidecars (OpenWebUI pipelines, any agent), CLI, and external integrations. Auth: Bearer API key OR X-Session-Token. Idempotency-Key is supported on all writes.

bearerAuth.description: Pod API key (Bearer) issued via /api/hub/setup/agent or pod admin tooling. Browser/web clients may use the X-Session-Token header instead. See GET /api/hub/auth/status to introspect the calling key.

Unauthorized.description: Auth failed. See `reason` field for the specific cause.

instanceLabel.description: The computer's name this key was made on; null = unlabelled.

approvalUrl.description: awaiting_approval: the page where the owner approves it.

replacedBy.description: revoked by replacement: when the replacing connection was created, and on which instance.

entityCount.description: Live (non-deleted) entity count in this workspace.

usedByProjectIds.description: Additive INDEX: project ids that use this workspace (project --uses--> workspace). Floored to projects the caller can see. Not an ACL.

provisioningStatus.description: Install lifecycle state stamped into settings by the applier. "failed" = a post-workspace layer did not apply; the workspace exists and is usable, and re-running the install resumes it. null/absent = the install completed.

failedStep.description: Which install layer failed, e.g. "post-workspace" (capabilities / playbooks / automations / loops / cells).

failedStepError.description: A fixed sentence for a failed apply (the raw cause stays in the operator log).

packageSlug.description: The CP package slug — the key `market update` takes. null when not package-source-linked, which includes EVERY capability row (see templateKey).

templateKey.description: capability rows only: the CP template key this container converged to. Not a catalog slug.

drift.description: true/false = computed. null = NOT computed for this kind in this mode — never a defaulted false.

lifecycle.description: workspace rows only: the template's catalog standing. `unlisted` only after a provably complete catalog sync, else `unknown`.

overlays.description: workspace rows only: each overlay composed onto the space (`installedPacks`), with its own catalog standing.

templateState.description: workspace rows only: the space's ONE template state (slug, version stamp, state building|active|awaiting-approval|partial|layer-2-not-run|failed, failedLayer, packs).

autoRespond.description: If true, the LAST user message in the batch fires an A2AI reply.

slot.description: An agent's question naming a slotLabel: 'blocked' when the question is now that output's ask; otherwise why not (unknown_label, already_done, no_session, not_found, failed).

autoRespond.description: If true and role=user, schedules an A2AI agent reply via pg-boss.

kind.description: An AGENT's post only: 'question' when the person is needed (in a session room it pushes them, once per session window); 'update' (default) for progress/results — in-app only, never a push.

slotLabel.description: With kind 'question' (agent posts only): the label of the session output the question is about. The question is filed ON that output (the owner's, with the question as its why), and the owner's answer is recorded as its `answer` and hands it back to the agent.

ask.description: With kind 'question' + slotLabel (agent posts only): HOW the person answers — the output's typed ask (confirm | choose | form | act | provide). Omit for a free-text answer.

effectiveWorkspaceId.description: Workspace the entity actually landed in. May be null for pod-wide profiles.

proposalType.description: Present when status is "proposed". "join" for a workspace-join gate, else "<subject>.<action>" (e.g. "entity.create").

reviewUrl.description: Present when status is "proposed". Absolute URL to review the proposal in the Studio.

deferred.description: Workspace-join gate only (proposalType "join"): this write was KEPT on the join request and is replayed for you once the join is approved — do not resend it.

ref.description: With `deferred`: the kept write's ref on the join proposal.

facets.description: Kind + Facets: per-role attach outcome for any `facets` passed in the request (status attached/proposed/error).

didYouMean.description: Closest valid property slug, when the key looks like a typo.

unmodeled.description: Property keys written but NOT modelled by the profile. Stored verbatim (the write succeeded) but not queryable.

properties.description: Present only when the write carried keys the profile does not model.

userId.description: Owner of the entity. Defaults to the authenticated user.

agentUserId.description: Agent user that performed the write. Used for proposal authorship.

workspaceId.description: Target workspace. Falls back to profile.entityScope and the user's first accessible workspace.

projectId.description: File the new entity into a project (its entity id). Stamps a belongs_to_project edge at materialization, so project-scoped recall (ask with projectId) finds it. Orthogonal to workspaceId.

profileSlug.description: Profile slug. Provide profileSlug, profileId, or the deprecated `type` alias.

profileId.description: Profile UUID. Resolved to the profile's slug server-side; takes precedence over profileSlug/type.

type.description: Deprecated alias for profileSlug. Prefer profileSlug.

content.description: Long-form markdown body. When set, a linked, versioned document is created (MinIO-stored) instead of inlining into properties.

reasoning.description: The proposing agent's rationale for this action, surfaced in the proposal inbox.

sourceMessageId.description: Optional message ID that triggered this write (for event chain causality).

sessionId.description: Optional session ID to link proposals created by this write to an active focus session.

facets.description: Kind + Facets: role-profiles to attach to the new entity in the same call (each via the governed attachFacet door). Applied only when the entity materializes. `slug` is canonical; `profileSlug` is accepted as an alias for parity with the /structure and tRPC facet shapes.

forceCreate.description: Bypass the weak same-name create gate when a same-profile entity with this title already exists. Prefer reusing the existing id. Does not bypass strong-signal auto-merge (email/phone/url).

externalId.description: Strong cross-source identity anchor for this subject, as `provider:id` (e.g. `discord:123456789012345678`). Registered as an `external_id` identity signal so a later create with the SAME value auto-resolves to the same entity (dedup) instead of minting a duplicate — the strong atom that the weak email/phone/url auto-extraction cannot express for opaque connector ids. Opaque and case-sensitive; the provider prefix namespaces the id.

expectedLabel.description: The declared session-output slot this entity fulfils, exactly as declared on the session's expected outputs. Left unset when the create doesn't fulfil a specific declared slot.

deferred.description: Workspace-join gate only (proposalType "join"): this write was KEPT on the join request and is replayed for you once the join is approved — do not resend it.

ref.description: With `deferred`: the kept write's ref on the join proposal.

reasoning.description: The proposing agent's rationale for this update, surfaced in the proposal inbox.

expectedStatus.description: Compare-and-set on the status: the status you SAW. If it moved meanwhile the call answers 409 with the current status and writes nothing.

crossKindCandidates.description: Same-title entities of a DIFFERENT kind. ADVISORY: `match` stays "none" because a title alone never auto-merges — but do NOT treat "none" as "safe to create" when this is non-empty. Prefer proposing a link to one of these over minting a duplicate.

pendingCandidates.description: Strong-signal matches in YOUR OWN pending capture proposals — a duplicate already in-flight but not yet committed (so `match` is still "none"). ADVISORY: carries a proposalId, NEVER an entityId — do NOT link to it (it can still be rejected). Wait for review or revise, rather than filing a second copy.

kindSlug.description: The entity kind (profile slug) being created. A weak (same-name) match must be this kind to become `match:'weak'`; cross-kind rows still ride in `candidates`.

title.description: Name/title to weak-match. Blank → strong-signal lookup only.

properties.description: Draft property bag — strong signals are also extracted from it (merged with `signals`).

lifetimeHours.description: Hours this proposal stays answerable once its context is gone. `null` for every class that never expires; only `ephemeral` has one.

ProposalClass.description: Decision class — derived from proposalType x targetType, not stored.

connection.description: PROVIDER (OAuth) connection only — a vault-kind requirement is already expressed by the params that feed it, and surfacing it twice makes a filled form still read 'needs a connection'.

blocking.description: Any REQUIRED param unsatisfied, or a REQUIRED provider connection not `connected`.

secret.description: Prompt masked. The VALUE is never on the wire.

satisfied.description: A non-blank value is present, or a resolvable `vault://` ref is.

ref.description: `vault://<id>` when this param points at a vault secret.

refName.description: The linked secret's vault NAME. A label, never a value.

refService.description: The linked secret's category, e.g. `Stripe`. Never a value.

refUnresolved.description: The ref does not resolve for this caller (deleted, or not theirs). Distinct from 'not filled in yet' — the surface must say so.

materializedIds.description: Applied composites / plans only: op ref → the real id that op produced (`linked` = an existing row it reused; `revertedAt` = undone since). Absent until the proposal applies — refs never map to guessed ids.

summary.description: Author-written one-liner, capped at 280 chars. Omitted entirely when the proposal carries none — never generated.

lifetimeHours.description: Hours this proposal stays answerable once its context is gone. `null` for every class that never expires; only `ephemeral` has one.

ProposalStatus.description: Defaults to `pending`. Use `all` to return every status. `auto_approved` returns the audit receipts of agent writes that were executed immediately under governance rather than queued for review.

parameters.description: The capability's own inputs, passed to the skill sandbox as `args` — e.g. { to, subject, body } for gmail_send.

workspaceId.description: Acting workspace — an optional lens narrowing the skill lookup and the gate. Omit for a pod-wide run.

connectionSelector.description: Which of the capability's connections this run uses, when it has more than one. A selector matching nothing fails the run.

idempotencyKey.description: A stable key correlating retries of THIS logical run, so an external-send verb is at-most-once. Omitted → a content hash is derived.

channelId.description: Instruction-provenance: the acting channel of this agent turn. A run triggered from an untrusted-origin channel force-proposes instead of auto-running.

sourceMessageId.description: The triggering inbound message id, resolved server-side to the acting channel when channelId is not passed explicitly.

sessionId.description: The focus session this run belongs to. Persisted as the proposals.session_id column so a reviewer sees which operation the action was part of.

visibility.description: VISIBILITY (from the profile's scope column): who can use this profile type. Distinct from `scope` above, which is placement.

applicableKinds.description: For profileKind='role': the kind slugs this role may attach to (null/absent = any kind).

schemaScope.description: base = global/profile definition; workspace = explicit overlay

displayOrder.description: The resolver's own field order (`compareEffectiveProperties`: base layer before overlay, then displayOrder, then slug). The projection dropped it until 2026-09-21, which is why no schema-derived form/projection could be built from this door.

uiHints.description: The stored `uiHints` blob (PropertyUIHints): placeholder, inputType, displayAs, format, includeTime, linkedProfileSlug, helpText, description, readOnly, … Emitted whole rather than cherry-picked — a per-key allowlist is exactly how `displayOrder` and most of this object went missing. Labels and options are NOT read from here; they come from the shared resolvers.

filled.description: Entities with a non-empty value for this property.

sampleSize.description: Entities of this kind at this lens — the denominator. Counted over `entities` itself, so a property-less entity IS counted.

fill.description: TWO NUMBERS, never a ratio — the consumer divides. ABSENT = not requested (?fill=true) or unreadable: UNMEASURED. `sampleSize === 0` = the kind has no entities at this lens: UNMEASURABLE (new kind / cold start), NOT zero. `sampleSize > 0 && filled === 0` = a real measured zero. A `fillRate: number` collapses all three into `0`. This is a TIEBREAKER for ranking fields, never a gate — nothing filters a property out on it.

schemaUnavailable.description: Present when this row's schema could not be read by its own identity at this lens. `properties` is then EMPTY BY WITHHOLDING, not because the type has none.

slugWritesTo.description: Present when `properties` is this row's own schema but a write that names this slug at this lens lands on ANOTHER row (`profileId`) and is validated against that row's schema instead.

createCommand.description: Ready-to-run CLI command template for this profile. ABSENT when `schemaUnavailable` or `slugWritesTo` is set: a create command for a type whose schema this response could not show — or whose slug writes to another row — invites exactly the blind write those markers exist to prevent.

type.description: Browser-routable label for the given ID — an `object-nav.ts` case label, one of: agent, automation, capability, channel, document, entity, playbook, project, proposal, run, session, skill, tool, view, workspace, unknown. Never a free string: see resolve-browser-route.ts.

Set/merge the workspace-EDGE fields on an existing workspace: `sourceRoles` (domain → provider|consumer|provider-consumer) and `defaultSources` (domain → source workspace to read from). Merges per-domain — existing domains and all other settings are preserved, never clobbered. Editor+ membership required. GOVERNED: rewiring cross-workspace read routing goes through review — an agent caller gets `{ status: 'proposed', proposalId }` (applied on approval); an operator-authority caller applies immediately (`{ status: 'updated' }`).

Set the workspace's public-projection config: `enabled` (master switch), `roles` (facet role-profile slugs whose holders are public) and `fields` (property-key allowlist for a projected row). Writes ONLY the `publicProjection` settings key — all other settings are preserved, never clobbered. Editor+ membership required. GOVERNED: opting into an unauthenticated public surface goes through review — an agent caller gets `{ status: 'proposed', proposalId }` (applied on approval); an operator-authority caller applies immediately (`{ status: 'updated' }`).

post.summary: Create a workspace from a WorkspaceProposal definition
post.description: Idempotently provisions a workspace from a WorkspaceProposal-shaped definition. Restricted to agent users whose agentType is in the allowlist (currently `eve`, `coder`). Pass a stable `proposalId` to make retries idempotent — the same id for the same user returns the existing workspace with `created: false`.

get.summary: List everything installed on this pod, per kind
get.description: Unions the install ledgers that already exist — workspaces (package_slug + version stamp), capability containers (template_key + contentHash), the marketSource-linked view/skill/automation rows, and package cells (cell:<pkg>:<key> + version). Cheap by default: no network. Pass `drift=true` to additionally run the standalone dry-run reconcile, which costs one Control-Plane fetch per distinct package slug. `drift: null` on a row means NOT COMPUTED, never 'up to date'. Requires hub-protocol.read scope.

get.summary: AI capture-routing health (decision vs. correction events)
get.description: Computes routing accuracy from ai_decision (kind=route) and ai_correction (kind=route) events: overall accuracy, applied rate, a per-target-workspace breakdown (which workspaces get mis-routed to), and a confidence-calibration table (does stated confidence track real accuracy). Returns nulls (never divide-by-zero) when there is no data yet in the window.

Reports whether the pod's downstream dependencies are reachable — currently the Intelligence Service. Separate from GET /health, which is an unauthenticated liveness probe and deliberately performs no network I/O. The IS URL is resolved through the SAME resolution real requests use (capability-first → workspace → user → pod default → env fallback), so the probe cannot check a URL requests never touch. Always returns 200 with a reported state: an unreachable dependency is data, not an error. `state` distinguishes `unreachable` (URL known, probe failed) from `unresolved` (resolution itself failed).
